mlp.name: MLP · Regularized
mlp.description: Two dense layers with BatchNorm and Dropout for tabular data with more variation.

unet.name: U-Net · Normalized
unet.description: Adds BatchNorm, activation and Dropout at the bottleneck for more stable segmentation.

compact.name: MLP · Compact
compact.description: One small hidden layer to iterate quickly or work with little data.
compact.benefit: fast to train and easy to interpret

standard.name: CNN · Standard classifier
standard.description: Two Conv–BatchNorm–ReLU blocks with pooling and global average. Good starting point for real images.
standard.benefit: combines capacity, stability and moderate size

deep_regularized.name: CNN · Deep with regularization
deep_regularized.description: Four convolutions, two spatial scales and Dropout 2D for more demanding visual classification.
deep_regularized.tradeoff: more parameters and higher overfitting risk

resnet.name: CNN · Residual block
resnet.description: Two convolutions and a fully visible identity branch.

gru.name: Recurrent · GRU
gru.description: Compact recurrent unit without separate cell state.

bidirectional.name: LSTM · Bidirectional
bidirectional.description: Reads the sequence in both directions before producing the final prediction.
bidirectional.tradeoff: not appropriate for strictly real-time prediction

stacked.name: LSTM · Stacked
stacked.description: Two recurrent layers with Dropout for richer temporal dynamics.

light.name: U-Net · Light
light.description: Compact encoder–decoder to quickly try masks and segmentation formats.

customPreset.description: Custom model saved from the builder.
customPreset.tradeoff: depends on the current dataset dimensions
